title: log μ = 0.5 + 0.2x
caption: At x = 5, μ = e^1.5 ≈ 4.48. The mean curves upward because each unit of x multiplies it by e⁰·² ≈ 1.22.
alt: Graph of μ = e^(0.5 + 0.2x), increasing and curving upward, with the point (5, 4.48).
description: The linear predictor is 0.5 + 0.2x; the mean is its exponential.
At x = 5 the predictor is 1.5 and μ = 4.48.
